description: A plush, tufted leather lounge chair with a matching ottoman. The chair features a high back, rolled arms, and a deep seat, all upholstered in a rich, caramel-colored leather. The tufting creates a diamond pattern across the seat and back, adding a touch of classic elegance. The ottoman is also tufted and rests on a sleek, star-shaped metal base, mirroring the modern design of the chair's base. This set is designed for ultimate comfort and relaxation, perfect for a reading nook or a stylish living space.
